_doc: Emberwick, on Volcano (re-cut 2026-11-25: song bars 36-42, 48-65). The level is the story: bars 0-4 the verse's end, cold, every good tap relighting a zone; 4 the held bar, the Kindling rises; 5-6 the stabs, the Meteor given (5, played for him), the switchback (6); 7 the riser, Helion's moment, one held dash; 8-15 the drop, the forge relit, Ossa hammering; 15 the breath; 16-23 the second half, the double hits, the forge sprint (19-21); 24 the last stabs and silence, the star rises from the forge.
Every bar is charted by hand (presses.json). Swung sixteenths. The id is the world's slot, not the song: saves, scenes and stars are kept under it.
title: Volcano (feat. Scarlett)
adds: The Meteor: tap to dash through walls

setpieces.name: The Meteor
setpieces.what: the Kindling opens its wings across the path; the first walls are broken for you, then you dash the rest on the stabs

setpieces.name: The switchback
setpieces.what: after a bar of your own dashes, on the riser: Ossa's ringing turns the orbit round (one of the level's two turns, outside the drop)

setpieces.name: Ossa's hammer
setpieces.what: the drop's great node is her first strike; at 24.0, 28.8 and 33.6 her strikes rise under the course as rings of fire that launch you high like pads, over the walls (to 36.0)

setpieces.name: Into the core
setpieces.what: the camera dives through the forge's mouth; the last stretch runs inside the planet's glowing heart, a new place and look; the forge sprint at 45.6

setpieces.name: The seal
setpieces.what: the last wall is the Stillness's seal on the star, a ring of ink across the core; one dash on the song's last stab breaks it and the star bursts free
